title: Imported executable plan contract
rules: Import preserves the source path, source hash, title, ordered tasks, dependencies, and acceptance checks.
Missing task ids are generated deterministically from the plan id and heading order.
Import never starts a provider, agent, device, or write action.
Start requires explicit approval for the exact source hash and revision.
Pause stops new dispatch; resume continues the same plan id and task ids.
Completed tasks are never dispatched again after restart or resume unless an explicit reasoned reopen invalidates them.
Reopening completed work preserves old evidence, requires fresh evidence, and reopens completed dependents.
Interrupted tasks resume the same child when supported or become an explicit retry attempt.
No more than two root tasks run concurrently; excess ready tasks remain queued.
Every automatic route records candidates, required capabilities, capacity, cost, reasoning effort, rationale, and isolation.
A user provider, model, reasoning effort, agent, skill, tool, or isolation override is authoritative.
User-defined assignment constraints are preserved in the worker brief and assignment evidence.
A Watch-held route is never called; fallback requires a recorded reason and remains within the approved plan.
Visual UI and UX tasks require a bounded Kimi K3 visual route unless the user overrides or accepts an explicit unavailable result.
Peer requests and replies carry plan id, task id, immutable sender and target ids, correlation id, reply id, and attempt.
An ordinary unassigned checklist step completes from its required evidence without an auditor.
An assigned builder step cannot complete from its own note; a fresh read-only sibling auditor on a different callable vendor must return HEAD, GATE, LAST, and passing STATUS.
An auditor receipt applies only to assigned builder steps and cannot complete untouched checklist steps.
Elevate and vendor asks wait; a product ask on a running plan or active goal states a recommendation and default, then continues.
